description: Scoop your first piece of junk.
Press 10 pure bales (one kind of junk only).
Press 10 lumpy bales. They still count.
Clear 100 kg of paper and fabric.
Spend an hour on the planet.
Find a curiosity that only lives in the wilderness.
Visit wilderness bases in three different biomes.
Bring the Cradle home: three districts in bloom, or 1% of the planet reclaimed.
Twelve districts in bloom, or 3% of the planet reclaimed.
Build a recharge pad at an outpost.
Style a robot with all five custom parts in the Locker.
Fit the full Maker set (shell, optic and glider) on one robot.
Pet the same cat until she adopts you.
Spot a deer at the edge of the green.
See fish in a clean lake.
Photograph 6 different animals in photo mode.
Place a decoration in Garden Mode.
Place every kind of decoration at least once.
Light the Cradle Returns beacon and hear from the ark.
Unlock 6 songs on the base radio.
Unlock every song on the base radio.
Collect 4 pictures in the photo album.
Retire a robot to the nursery garden.
Say hi to the nursery caretakers 5 times.
